rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers L3 'It found what you asked it to look for' and L5 'It analysed everything and still had no insight' open on a failure mode as a negative case, but L15 and L13 name the disciplines (diagnose before rewriting; go looking for your wrong); the lecture title 'Why it agreed' is a question, and the lecture resolves into disciplines. Closest: L5 header is failure-led; body hands the discipline question ('what is the insight only your team can bring?').

Facets: front-run (no skill-by-name or later-module terms in body; grep M[0-9] -> 0); module-to-module arc (hands to whats-actually-true.md L32 which includes this lecture; close ends on diagnose-then-rerun-smallest-step, leaves the truth-testing for the module); Big Idea (control: trace agreement to question and instructions, matches maintainer Learning line); mood does not resolve early (slide 5 leaves 'Nobody knows' open, slide 7 gives a diagnosis order, not a verification step that closes the unease).
